summary: - _c) Condone the delay in commissioning of above-mentioned assets as the reasons mentioned at para 6 are beyond the control of petitioner and allow IDC and IEDC as claimed in the petition._ - _d) Allow the petitioner to recover the shortfall or refund the excess Annual Fixed Charges, on account of Return on Equity due to change in applicable Minimum Alternate/Corporate Income Tax rate as per the Income Tax Act, 1961 (as amended from time to time) of the respective financial year directly without making any application before the Commission as provided in Tariff Regulation 2019 as per para 8 above for respective block._ - _h) Allow the Petitioner to claim the overall security expenses and consequential IOWC on that security expenses separately._ - _i) Allow the petitioner to claim the capital spares at the end of tariff block as per actual._ _and pass such other relief as Hon’ble Commission deems fit and appropriate under the circumstances of the case and in the interest of justice.”_ 6. The Petitioner has served a copy of the Petition on the Respondents, and notice regarding the filing of this Petition has been published in the newspapers in accordance with Section 64 of the Electricity Act, 2003. No comments or suggestions have been received from the general public in response to the aforesaid notice published in the newspapers by the Petitioner. Respondent No. 1, Madhya Pradesh Power Management Company Limited (MPPMCL), Respondent No. 3, Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Company (MSEDCL) and Respondent No. 9, Torrent Power Limited (TPL) have filed their replies vide affidavits dated 30.7.2024, 28.3.2024 and 4.10.2024, respectively. 8. Therefore, the Petitioner is directed to submit the requisite 25. Respondent No. 3, i.e., Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Company Limited (MSEDCL) vide the affidavit dated 28.3.2024, submitted that even though the associated system was not ready for evacuation of the power due to abandonment of the project by DGENTCL, the Petitioner failed to consider the alternate utilization for evacuation of the power. Further, MSEDCL has submitted that the Petitioner was aware from the early stages of the project's implementation that the associated systems assigned for development to DGENTCL would not be completed. It was imprudent on the part of the Petitioner to act steadfastly, knowing that the associated systems would not be developed, and to seek to pass on the additional costs due to project delays to its beneficiaries and consumers.
